youtube_description:
I've been doing intermittent fasting for about 10 years. In this video, I'm going to show you why it's the simplest way to get six pack abs, exactly how I do it, how to start, and the three mistakes that will ruin your results.

See what you'd look like with a six-pack, free:
https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=longform&utm_content=ro08-intermittent-fasting

My daily fast:
Wake up around 9 AM, no breakfast, cold brew black coffee, first meal around 2 PM. That's about a five hour fasting window every morning, and I keep that first meal low carb, usually a salad.

How to start:
1. Month one: just skip breakfast. Keep everything else you eat the same, and don't move your breakfast calories to later in the day
2. Drink black coffee to keep the hunger away (I like cold brew, it's easier on your stomach)
3. Push lunch back 30 minutes at a time, about a month each step, until you're fasting five hours after you wake up
4. Next level: break your fast with a salad or a low carb meal

The 3 mistakes:
1. Binge eating at night
2. Eating within two hours of bedtime
3. Breaking your fast with alcohol (no alcohol until at least 30 minutes after your first meal)

The first couple of weeks are hard. Your digestive system adapts the same way your muscles adapt to workouts. For me, the hunger was nearly gone after 30 days and almost totally gone after 90.

The short version: Why I Skip Breakfast Every Single Day
